alt: Forensic regulatory audit of the October 2024 L.A. Care–DMHC–DHCS $55 Million Joint Enforcement Settlement, documenting point-in-time backlogs, fund flows, and legal pre-suit leverage.
full_text: Forensic Regulatory Audit of the L.A. Care–DMHC–DHCS $55 Million Joint Enforcement Settlement. Exposing the real backlog figures, fine allocations, and lack of direct compensation. In resolving OAH No. 2022060293 and related DMHC enforcement matters, L.A. Care entered a public settlement addressing DMHC allegations of systemic grievance, utilization-management, claims, provider-dispute and administrative-capacity failures. The settlement records an adjusted population of 65,423 grievances not timely resolved through December 17, 2021 and a 9,125-request authorization backlog during April–June 2021, and subjects the same operational domains to independent corrective monitoring.
summary: Forensic regulatory audit of the October 2024 L.A. Care–DMHC–DHCS $55 Million Joint Enforcement Settlement, documenting point-in-time backlogs, fund flows, and legal pre-suit leverage.
